_help: Read by scripts/hooks/guard_paths.py on every Write/Edit. protected: globs (repo-relative, '/' separators, '*' crosses folders) no agent may write. append_only: folders of ordered history (migrations); only the newest entry by name may change, new entries may be added. Example: "append_only": ["db/migrations"], "protected": ["tests/fixtures/golden/*"]. Bash is not covered: a sed -i is not stopped.
